newsitem.title: UKRAINE: IMF visits Ukraine for talks on $2.5-$3 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: IMF visits Ukraine for talks on $2.5-$3 bln loan.

text.p: International Monetary Fund (IMF) officials will discuss prospects for a multi-billion-dollar Extended Fund Facility to Ukraine during a three-day staff visit due to start on Tuesday, a spokesman for the Fund said.
"The director of the IMF's European II Department, John Odling-Smee, is arriving later today. He will meet a number of senior officials from the Ukrainian authorities," the IMF official told Reuters.
